sources.location: deposited LADC_PRIDE_raw_files_sample_ID.xlsx (RAW sample number → pLADC-NN / mLADC-NN)
RAW headers read by HTTP range request (instrument string; see scratchpad/PXD027259/evidence/raw_header_check.json)

claims.value: pLADC-01..20 (primary) and mLADC-01..20 (brain metastasis) from patients LADC-01..20
claims.evidence: ID sheet maps every RAW sample number; Table S1 row LADC-19 metastasis tumour content 3.6 % = paper's outlier mLADC-19, confirming mLADC-NN ↔ LADC-NN

claims.value: fast (LADC-01..11, lung–brain interval ≤ 365 d) vs slow (LADC-12..20)

claims.evidence: Table S1 Gender (1 male, 2 female), Age at diagnosis (half-years kept as 6M; metastasis rows = age + lung-brain interval), Smoking (2/1/0), pathological stage I–IV, EGFR/KRAS status

claims.value: CAM fixed; Ox M, Acetyl protein N-term variable; 10 ppm / 0.02 Da; Lys-C + trypsin
claims.evidence: Supplementary Methods (PD 2.4, S-Trap LysC then trypsin, DTT, IAA)

limitations: characteristics[age]: Table S1 'Age' is age at LADC diagnosis in half-years (README sheet). Because the rounding convention is not stated, every row gives the whole-year range covering [age − 0.25, age + 0.5) years; metastasis rows first add the lung–brain interval (age at brain-metastasis diagnosis). Primary rows use age at diagnosis as age at resection.
Disease staging: primary rows carry the pathological stage at diagnosis (Table S1); metastasis rows are stage IV, since a brain metastasis is distant (M1) disease.
Run batch is confounded with tissue: primary tumours were run in the 20191128/20191201 batches, metastases in the 20191206 'LUAD_B' batch.
FFPE preservation is stated in the report only (no licensed SDRF column).
mLADC-19 (outlier, 3.6 % tumour) is kept; the paper excluded it from group comparisons.
reconcile flags Trypsin/Lys-C as not named in the PRIDE record; both are in the supplementary methods.
